reddit.title: Exciting Water Improvements in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant updates to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse flow system, water depth is now managed more efficiently, allowing for smoother gameplay when shaping the landscape. This means you can raise lips, dig ditches, and flip wells without causing frame freezes. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Mechanics Update!
steam.body: We've just released an update that transforms how water behaves in Provincia. The new native sparse flow system allows for real-time updates to water depth as you modify the terrain, ensuring a more immersive building experience. Say goodbye to freezing frames when interacting with water features! Read more about this update here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
